data.name: Cnaught
data.description: CNaught is a US-based carbon credit marketplace and portfolio provider that curates diversified bundles of high-integrity carbon credits (including both avoided emissions and engineered carbon removal) for small and mid-sized business buyers. It does not operate removal projects itself but resells credits from suppliers such as Charm Industrial, Heirloom, CarbonCapture and Lithos, and provides diligence, reporting and API tools.
